newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures recoup, end little changed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures recoup, end little changed.

text.p: Dec 27 - U.S. stock index futures ended mixed, little-changed after March S&P 500s during the final minutes rallied back up. The contract had dropped quickly to moderate losses and the day's low during the final hour. But traders said the afternoon's moves were driven almost exclusively by locals, with price swings magnified by lack of outside participation.
